items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Monk is used as a form of address to the interviewer throughout the transcript; the interviewee discusses Benny Goodman but never mentions a personal or professional relationship with Thelonious Monk.

ctx.x: Okay. I was born in 1922. If I was born in 1922, Monk, and I heard Benny Goodman on the radio in 1934, how old was I?
